title: Universal Data Sanitizer, Deduplicator & Schema Mapper
target_pain: Developers, QA engineers, and data analysts waste hours manually cleaning messy CSV/JSON exports, removing duplicates, fixing broken JSON syntax, and mapping mismatched schemas before importing them into databases or test suites.
key_features: Auto-detects and parses messy CSV, TSV, and broken/malformed JSON
Dynamic schema mapping (rename, exclude, or retype fields on the fly)
Advanced deduplication based on custom primary keys
Instant format conversion (JSON to CSV, CSV to JSON)
Real-time data cleaning (strips nulls, trims whitespace, fixes trailing commas)
